outcomes.reason: POSIX permission bits do not exist on Windows: os.chmod only toggles the read-only attribute and stat.S_IMODE always reports 0o666/0o777, so the case can only ever fail there. The product still calls chmod (harmless, and correct everywhere else); expressing this restriction on Windows would mean ACLs, a mechanism the product does not use. The guarantee stays covered on macOS and Linux.
